name: a deal carried out as work: prepared in the room, then implemented and relayed
what_it_changes: P08 says rooms propose, settle and contest deals and hold each other to them. In these rooms a deal also takes work around it: members prepare it inside the room (local consensus, a contact, checks on the counterpart's credibility), and they carry it out by moving placed work, changing templates and bot targets, and relaying the terms to placers who do not know them.
